webster.text: Want of estate, or means of comfortable subsistence; penury; poverty.

example.quote: Yet many of the individuals who lent us money in the hour of our distress, are now reduced to indigence in consequence of our delinquency.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. DAVIE, July 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
